endorsements.quote: Instead of one-off exercises, violet teaming should become routine, with teams simulating scenarios to identify technical and human weaknesses.
In parallel, human factors specialists assess workflow friction points, clinical champions validate usability under stress, and privacy officers evaluate compliance gaps.

unlisted_practices: Conduct violet teaming exercises that combine red and blue team simulations with human factors, clinical, privacy and policy experts to test sociotechnical resilience of health IT systems.
Implement violet teaming upstream in training and development and recur it across the lifecycle of EHR systems.
Use lightweight violet teaming cycles to target high-risk handoffs between DoD, VA, TRICARE and civilian hospitals.
Use violet teaming to validate the usability and interpretability of exchanged data under TEFCA-aligned networks.

screen.reason: This brief report / framework paper proposes 'violet teaming' as a sociotechnical cybersecurity and governance framework for AI and EHR interoperability, using an illustrative vignette rather than an empirical evaluation.
